handyMigration.quitHandy:
Handy is still running, so Legato can't bring over your settings and history yet.

Quit Handy from its tray icon, then choose Retry. If you choose Cancel, Legato starts without them and won't ask again. They stay in Handy's folder.
handyMigration.filesInUse:
Something still has files open in Handy's folder, so Legato can't bring over your settings and history yet.

Close any program that might be using them, then choose Retry. If you choose Cancel, Legato starts without them and won't ask again. They stay in Handy's folder.
handyMigration.uninstallHandy:
Your settings, history and recordings are now in Legato.

Uninstall Handy so the two apps don't both run and fight over the same shortcut. Open Windows Settings to uninstall it?

style.title: Style
style.subtitle: Formatting per kind of app, picked from the app you dictate into.

last.label: Last dictation
last.howBody: Legato looks at the window you dictate into: the program, and in a browser the tab title. Each app or site belongs to one kind; Edit apps moves it to another.

perKind.title: Per kind of app
perKind.off: Style is off. Dictations get cleanup and your Settings › Output paste settings, the same in every app.

cleanup.title: Cleanup for every dictation

none.label: None
none.help: Pastes what the model heard, with Dictionary fixes and snippets only.

light.label: Light
light.help: Removes fillers, repeats and false starts; writes numbers as digits. No AI.

medium.label: Medium
medium.help: Light, then your AI smooths the grammar without changing what you said.

cleanup.mediumPreview: The example shows the Light rules; the AI step runs on real dictations.

fillers.title: Remove filler words
fillers.builtIn: The built-in list, plus fillers for the language you dictate in. Editing it makes your own list.

punctuation.title: Spoken punctuation
punctuation.help: Say “comma”, “period”, “question mark” or “new line” to type them.

corrections.title: Self-corrections
corrections.help: “at 3, actually 4” keeps 4; “scratch that” drops what came before it.

lists.title: Lists
lists.help: “first … second … third” becomes a list where the kind of app lays one out.

apps.none: No apps yet. Dictate into one, or add it with Edit apps.

notes.label: Notes
notes.help: Lists when you enumerate, no final periods

structured.label: Structured
structured.help: Paragraphs, numbered lists when you enumerate

sentence.label: Sentence
sentence.help: A capital and a final period

space.title: Trailing space
space.help: Keeps the next dictation from running into this one. Inherit is {{value}}, from Settings › Output.

pick.help: Dictating in these apps switches to this model, which takes a moment after dictating elsewhere.
pick.none: Download another model in Models to use it for these apps.

scratchpad.subtitle: A floating note you can type or dictate into instead of the app in front.

test.snoozed_other: In a real call, Legato would ask again in {{count}} minutes.

mic.sub: Legato listens only when you ask it to, and turns speech into text on this PC.
mic.accessHelp: Windows lets desktop apps use it.

mic.hearWait: Say something to check the level
mic.hearWaitSub: A sentence or two is plenty.
mic.hearOkSub: The level is good. Continue when you're ready.

mic.hearFailedSub: Pick another one, or check that it isn't muted.
mic.hearBlocked: Nothing comes through while Windows blocks the microphone
mic.noteWaiting: You can continue once Legato hears you
mic.noteBlocked: You can continue once Windows allows the microphone
